An '''ak tree''' was a species of [[Tree/Legends|tree]] found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. The [[Edge Forest]] was a home to a huge old ak tree whose hollowed trunk was a home to [[weave bird]]s.<ref name="Into the Void" />
